chapterPurpose: ‘Racing Seconds’ is developed as a mathematical investigation rather than a list of rules. The chapter connects seconds, minutes, elapsed time, clock reading, duration. Learners are expected to represent quantities or relationships, choose a strategy, calculate carefully, check the result and explain the reasoning.
